Admins can now rename their team from the profile page. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this is checked.

- **API:** `features/teams/api/update-team.ts` sends `PATCH /teams/{teamId}` with `{ name }`. The name is validated with Zod (trimmed, required). On success it refreshes the cached teams list.
- **Rename drawer:** `features/teams/components/update-team.tsx` is a form drawer with a Team Name field. Saving shows a "Team Updated" success notification, the same way the profile update does.
- **Team section:** `features/teams/components/team-section.tsx` shows the current user's team name. The Rename button only appears for admins. It finds the team by looking up the user's `teamId` in the existing teams list, so I added no new get-team call.
- **Profile page:** `profile.tsx` renders the Team section below the user information.
- **Mock backend:** `PATCH /teams/:teamId` in `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` requires an admin and only lets them rename their own team. The mock rejects other teams with a 401 and an unknown team with a 404.

The success message appears as a toast notification rather than text inside the page.
